title: k-nearest neighbors, vectorized
hints: ||a - b||^2 = ||a||^2 - 2 a.b + ||b||^2. With A (n, d) and B (m, d): (A**2).sum(1)[:, None] - 2 * A @ B.T + (B**2).sum(1)[None, :] gives the full (n, m) matrix with one matrix product. Clip at 0: rounding can make a true 0 come out as -1e-15.
The k nearest training rows for every test row at once: np.argpartition(D, k - 1, axis=1)[:, :k] on the (m_test, n_train) distance matrix, or np.argsort if k is small relative to n.

Vote without loops: map labels to 0..C-1 with np.unique(return_inverse=True), one-hot the neighbor labels to (m_test, k, C), sum over k, then argmax over C. argmax returns the first maximum, so with classes in sorted order the tie goes to the smallest label.
